title: Helping Colonials
summary:
Helping Colonials
Over the years, oil refineries along the US Northeast Coast have hit their share of economic potholes. Many of these plants were built around processing mainly light, low sulfur crude oils predominantly from West Africa. Until a few years ago, this limited menu of oil flavors still provided financial returns sufficient to warrant operating the refineries.
